summary.text: Brian Chirichiello is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2010 to 2020, representing Rockingham 6.

paragraphs.text: Brian Chirichiello assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives in 2010, representing Rockingham 6, and left office on December 1, 2020.
He did not run for re-election in 2020.
Chirichiello advanced from the Republican primary for Rockingham 13 on September 8, 2026.
